dataset_name: CWC River Water Level & Telemetry Hydrometry Records
source_agency: Central Water Commission (CWC), Ministry of Jal Shakti, Govt of India
spatial_resolution: Point river gauge stations (designated river basins and sub-basins)
license_or_access_notes: India-WRIS / CWC Flood Forecast System open data portal. Restricted or non-public for classified transboundary river reaches (e.g., Indus/Brahmaputra special agreements).
notes: Hourly river stage gauge levels allow monitoring the rate of rise (delta 6h, delta 24h). Water levels exceeding Danger Level represent immediate overbank risk.
